title: Hiring with AI -Talent Filter
prompt:
Act as a structured hiring consultant.
Role I am hiring for  :  [JOB TITLE AND KEY RESPONSIBILITIES]
Team context             :  [STAGE, CULTURE, WHO THEY WILL WORK WITH]
Non-negotiables        :  [MUST-HAVE SKILLS OR EXPERIENCE]
Step 1  :  Define the top 4 success criteria for this role 
                what does excellent performance look like in year one?
Step 2 :  For each criterion, write 2 STAR-format behavioural interview questions.
               (Tell me about a time when...)
Step 3 :  For each question, define what a strong answer looks like vs a weak answer   
               2 lines each.
Step 4 :  Write one work sample task I could give candidates to test the most critical  
               skill directly.
Step 5 :  Write 3 red-flag signals to watch for in interviews.
Talent Filter Hiring Process
Deﬁne Success Criteria Consistent Scoring Rubric
Establish 3-5 key criteria for Use a rubric for fair and
success consistent scoring
Behavioral Questions AI-Assisted Analysis
Ask STAR format questions Analyze candidate data with
for each criterion AI tools
PRO TIP
The work sample task (Step 4) is the single highest-signal hiring tool available. A 2-hour
task relevant to the actual job outpredicts any amount of interviewing. Candidates who
decline the task often self-select out for good reason. Candidates who complete it
brilliantly and explain their thinking are almost always the right hire.
